Marta Chen: Heads-up — Sundial Finance's APAC pilot is failing onboarding E2E tests, getting 5xx from ap-northeast-1 edge.
Marta Chen: They're up for renewal next month; CS flagged this as high priority. Request: temporary QPS increase + IP allowlist so their CI fleet can finish validation.
Priya Nair: What exact QPS, CIDRs, and duration? Please include auto-revoke timestamp so we can avoid manual cleanup.
Marta Chen: Customer: sundial-finance (SF-7721). Requesting 1,200 QPS in ap-northeast-1 for 72h. CIDRs:
13.45.23.1/32
13.45.23.2/32
3.112.56.8/32
Expire: 2025-06-01T18:00:00Z
Reason: their integration harness simulates peak traffic; without this they can't complete the pilot and renewal conversation stalls.
Adeel Khan: I can add a soft override in proxy. Eng-sre needed to adjust regional rate-window; infra to add peering ACLs. Auto-revoke timestamp is fine.
infra-bot: Created ticket INC-8342; assignees: @Adeel @Priya. SLA: same business day.
Priya Nair: Planned steps (audit): 1) patch rate-window ap-northeast-1 for SF-7721 to 1200 QPS (soft)
2) add CIDRs to proxy allowlist
3) add /32s to peering ACL
4) schedule auto-revoke and alert on unexpected spikes
Priya Nair: Dry-run payload:
POST /admin/v1/customers/SF-7721/rate-window
{ "region": "ap-northeast-1", "qps": 1200, "mode": "soft", "expires_at": "2025-06-01T18:00:00Z" }
Adeel Khan: Oncall note: after proxy override I'll run this check:
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_ADMIN" "https://infra-admin.internal/regions/ap-northeast-1/quotas?customer=SF-7721"
Theo Ruiz: I'll push peering ACLs and relax any CDN/WAF rules for the three IPs. Will add short TTL to allowlist for auto-revoke.
Priya Nair: Canary applied in staging; rolling to prod in 10m. Will post canary logs.
infra-bot: INC-8342 updated: canary passed at 5230001333; prod push scheduled in 5m. Auto-revoke set to 2025-06-01T18:00:00Z.
Adeel Khan: Prod push complete. Proxy shows quota 1200 QPS for SF-7721. Quick smoke from their CI: 0/3 5xx, responses look healthy.
Theo Ruiz: Peering ACLs + CDN edge allowlist updated. WAF relaxed for the three CIDRs only.
Marta Chen: Great. I'll notify Sundial to re-run full-suite and capture p95/p99 after changes. Please add a short renewal-risk note to INC-8342 for the renewal manager.
Priya Nair: Will attach p95/p99 snapshots and post full-suite status in the ticket in 30m.
Marta Chen: Thanks team :tada: Please @mention me on INC-8342 when prod changes are live.
